description: Extension: XML fragments kept verbatim from an imported Office Open XML presentation for ONE owner node, so that exporting back to that format loses nothing. Opaque to this profile: a reader may skip the node and loses no content this profile defines.

entries.description: The fragments, in the order of a depth-first walk of the owner's payload.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, into the owner's payload, of the member this fragment is the value of. The last token is one of `raw_ext`, `raw`, `raw_extra`, `raw3d`, `xml`, `omml`; the member is absent from the owner's payload.

xml.description: The fragment: well-formed XML text in the Office Open XML vocabulary (ECMA-376), exactly as imported.

owner.description: The node_id of the node the fragments belong to.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1.

title: x.deckcraft.ooxml
